race.comment: The well-related SHE'S SPEEDY (6) (half to G3 winner Rich Fortune) has a handy record over this sprint journey with three wins and a second from just five attempts and will be high on confidence following that last-start Townsville victory. Handles all going and gun jockey Wiggins retains the ride. Should be right there at the business end. AIRBORNE HOTDOG (7) has hit a purple patch of late with two wins and two seconds from his past four outings. Can continue the rich vein of form. FAKE (9) got the job done at Atherton last time out and should get a gun run in transit from gate two. In the mix. FLORAL LEGEND (11) resumes here but showed enough when last in work to warrant consideration in a race like this. Can feature while fresh. CANNY PROSPECT (8) next in line.
